A project wiki with a spine."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# pi-canon"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Canonical project memory for the Pi coding agent. Every asset has at most one governing article, at "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"an address computed from the asset's own path: `src/core/config.ts` is governed by `articles/src/cor"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"e/config.md`. Beneath the articles sits an append-only journal, one file per event. When a tool call"},{"id":"p3s4","text":" touches a governed asset, that article's one dense line arrives in the session unasked, so the agen"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"t does not have to know there was something to look up. Detecting the path in a tool call is best ef"},{"id":"p3s6","text":"fort; resolving it to an article is not."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**One setup measured, others welcome.** pi-canon was developed and tested under one configuration: C"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"odex, with GPT 5.6 as the worker model, on an OpenAI subscription. Every number in this README was m"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"easured there. Other models, other providers, and API-metered access are untested. If you run it und"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"er a different setup, feedback is welcome and so are pull requests."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"*An illustrative store: 33 articles, 20 journal entries, 40 files. Discs are articles, rings are jou"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"rnal entries hanging under the article each was distilled into, and a square tethered beneath a disc"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" is the asset that article was named for. Six of the articles match no asset and hang untethered, be"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"cause free knowledge is not a special case here. Selecting a node opens what it holds, what it point"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"s at, and what points at it.*"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Pi"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Or clone this repo into `~/.pi/agent/extensions/`. Node 22.18 or later, Pi 0.83 or later on the 0.x "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"line. Nothing to configure: the store is created on first write at `<project>/.canon`. The package i"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"mports `node:fs` and `node:path` and nothing else, makes no network calls, runs no git, and loads un"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"der plain node with no build step."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Codex"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The repository is a Codex marketplace. Add it once, then install the plugin at user scope:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"For a local checkout under development, replace `shaneconner/canon` with its absolute path. Start a "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"new Codex thread after installing or updating it."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Claude Code"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The same repository is also a Claude Code marketplace:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Again, an absolute checkout path works for local development. Start a new Claude Code session after "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"installing or updating it."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Published separately on npm as `dsh-canon`, built from the same mirrored core. That build ships with"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"out the retriever and without the settings screen."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The Codex and Claude Code plugins launch the same dependency-free MCP server and expose the same `ca"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"non` actions as Pi. Codex surfaces after each tool result. Claude Code deduplicates one capsule pack"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"et across each parallel tool batch, immediately before the next model request, which avoids repeated"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" message framing without delaying the agent's next decision. Both give one write-after reminder befo"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"re the agent stops. An article surfaces at most once per compaction cycle: a compact starts a new cy"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"cle, while resuming the same uncompacted session does not. One session may contain several compactio"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"n cycles. Compaction discards prior touch state and replays nothing. After it, only a fresh tool-inp"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"ut path can surface that asset's exact or nearest-ancestor article; children and unrelated articles "},{"id":"p21s9","text":"do not ride along. The hooks are inert in projects without `.canon/articles`, and they never create "},{"id":"p21s10","text":"a store merely because a session opened. Review and approve the plugin hooks when the client asks. J"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"ournal entries written through the MCP server carry explicit `harness` provenance and a session iden"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"tifier when the client exposes one."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Defaults"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"What you have after installing, with nothing configured:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## The first article"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## What the code holds, and what it asks for"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"An immutable journal, an addressing spine, and recall that arrives unasked could sound like a design"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" that removed its dependency on model behavior. It did not. It moved that dependency to one side of "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"a line and constrained the other side, and the line is short enough to state in full."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Held by the runtime:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- A journal entry is created with the exclusive-create flag, so canon never rewrites or deletes one,"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" and a name collision increments a suffix rather than losing an entry. The files stay ordinary Markd"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"own, so any other tool can still rewrite or delete one: append-only is a property of the tool, not o"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"f the filesystem.
- Once a path is in hand it resolves to exactly one article, walking to the neares"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"t ancestor that has one, or to nothing at all.
- An article surfaces whole, with no character count "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"able to truncate it or hold it back.
- An article with a presence mark surfaces at most once while t"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"hat mark remains in the context the provider receives. Presence is read from that projection rather "},{"id":"p30s8","text":"than remembered, so folding or compaction returns a marked article to surfacing; an untestably short"},{"id":"p30s9","text":" delivery or a harness that reports no projection degrades to at most once per session.
- The Codex "},{"id":"p30s10","text":"and Claude Code hooks cannot inspect that projection. They use an explicit compaction cycle instead:"},{"id":"p30s11","text":" session start, context clear, and compaction discard prior touch state; resume does not. None of th"},{"id":"p30s12","text":"ose events surfaces an article. A later asset touch does. Codex delivers after each tool result; Cla"},{"id":"p30s13","text":"ude Code combines the current parallel batch into one packet before the next model request.
- Readin"},{"id":"p30s14","text":"g an article through the tool withdraws its staged capsule before the message goes out.
- Read-only "},{"id":"p30s15","text":"tools can surface an article but never arm its write-after reminder. A successful modifying tool can"},{"id":"p30s16","text":"ools can surface an article but never arm its write-after reminder. A successful modifying tool can."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Asked of the agent, and checked by nothing:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Read the governing article before working on an asset, and update it after real changes. No write "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"is gated on a prior read, and the settle reminder is a message rather than a gate.
